note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Rumored Jul 17 GA day has arrived with no model card, pricing or API listing yet; a reported ground-up rebuild (2.5-Pro base scrapped), rumored 2M context and Deep Think on the $250 Ultra tier. Polymarket ~52% for a July window, 23% for none by Jul 31.
Polymarket conviction ~68% by Dec 31, ~40% by Sep 30, ~2% by Jul 31; OpenAI's roadmap still runs through GPT-5.x, pushing the numbered flagship to late 2026.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~96% by Oct 31, though the exact version is unannounced.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; Manifold prices Grok 5 at ~43% before Sep 2026, with a foundation floated but undated.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported Jul 24 developer deadline.
